RBI hikes rate, but analysts see shift to ‘calibrated tightening’ as bigger takeaway. How can this impact markets?
items.content: RBI’s 25-bps repo rate hike to 5.50% was largely expected, but its shift to ‘calibrated tightening’ surprised markets and signals that near-term rate cuts are unlikely. Analysts expect selective pressure on rate-sensitive sectors, while banks with stronger balance sheets may remain relatively better placed amid rising inflation and crude prices.

items.title: Trent’s Rs 1.80 lakh crore rout from peak: Has Q2 just flipped the script for Tata group’s retail crown jewel?
items.content: In Q2FY27, Trent demonstrated impressive financial performance, achieving a remarkable 23% increase in revenue compared to the previous year. This achievement is particularly noteworthy given the challenges other retailers faced during the festive period. With continued expansion in store locations for both Zudio and Westside, analysts are split on future prospects, balancing optimism for recovery against caution as the market awaits consistent revenue growth.

Humans may not be as hardwired for violence as we thought
items.content: A study comparing 100 primate species, including humans, suggests that everyday aggression and lethal violence did not evolve as part of the same simple behavioral spectrum. Species that frequently fight or show mild aggression are not necessarily more likely to kill rivals, while extreme acts such as infanticide and lethal attacks appear to follow their own evolutionary patterns.

items.title: Don't miss: Watch Saturn shine and Halley’s Comet debris streak across the sky
items.content: October skywatchers can see Saturn at opposition, catch meteors from Halley’s Comet during the Orionid peak, and watch the Moon sweep past the famous Pleiades star cluster. Moonlight may obscure some Orionids, but the best viewing should come before dawn after the Moon sets.
